game_concept: A action defense set in Mt. Pyre – Eruption Watch, the volcano watchtower: the forge smith must handle ash wraiths while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Compound Combo: Chain +=, -=, *= updates to hit a target value exactly.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Eruption Watch: the volcano watchtower
core_gameplay_loop: In Eruption Watch, repeat each round: Chain +=, -=, *= updates to hit a target value exactly. Each round, ash wraiths strike the lava bridge, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the energy value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the lava bridge from ash wraiths in Eruption Watch: keep the energy meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 43-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: energy drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 43-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 9 (extended tier): Compound Combo
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how energy changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ash wraiths in Eruption Watch.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 43 seconds while energy > 0.
